real: A buried $60 million treasure is supposedly mapped by a cipher nobody has cracked in 140 years
source: The Beale ciphers — three ciphertexts from an 1820s Virginia land sale; one allegedly locates a buried cache of gold, silver and jewels still estimated at $60M+, and it's never been solved.

real: A physicist claims pendulums mysteriously sway during solar eclipses

real: A Soviet missile ignites on the launch pad — and the government buries the story for decades
